title: Rational curves on cubic hypersurfaces in positive characteristic
summary: We study the moduli spaces of rational curves on cubic hypersurfaces in characteristic $\neq2,3$. As a result, we prove that for every integer $d\geq1$ the Kontsevich moduli space of stable maps on a smooth cubic hypersurface $X$ of degree $d$ is irreducible if the dimension of $X$ is greater than or equal to $4$.
